purpose: Screen the complete retained CPLEX-backed day corpus for reproducible stress signals without selecting dates after observing atlas metrics.
population_rule: Include every unique day with an input SHA-256 and result-tree SHA-256 in the three named retained manifests. Classify rather than exclude a non-successful CPLEX summary. Exclude result-free 2022 input-only days because the atlas is an output-screening study.

declared_categories.high-energy-price: maximum CPLEX node price is at least the registered high-energy threshold
declared_categories.negative-energy-price: minimum CPLEX node price is below the registered negative-energy threshold
declared_categories.high-reserve-price: maximum CPLEX FIR or SIR price is at least the registered reserve threshold
declared_categories.network-stress: maximum absolute branch flow/capacity is at least the registered utilization threshold
declared_categories.violation: maximum reported violation MW exceeds the threshold or total reported violation cost is positive
declared_categories.solve-failure: at least one CPLEX summary row does not report solve status 1

causal_boundary: Categories are screening signals only. Asset outages, scarcity causes, and causal market effects require a separate input-based diagnosis and a baseline/counterfactual replay.
